body.p: In response to the Office Action mailed October 10, 2024 claims 1, 3, 11, and 13 have been amended. No new matter has been introduced. Accordingly, claims 1, 3-11, and 13-20 remain pending.
As an initial matter, Applicant appreciates the Examiner's indication that claims 1, 3-11 and 13-20 would be allowable if amended to overcome the rejections under 35 U.S.C. § 112(b).
Claims 1 and 11 have been amended to replace "the distance" with "a distance," as
With these amendments, Applicant submits the claims are definite and the § 112(b) rejections have been overcome,

In view of the foregoing, it is submitted that the claims now presented in this application define patentable subject matter. Accordingly, reconsideration and allowance of the application is requested.
